diagnosis: The check C3 and C6 passed in all rollouts because the model defaulted to a 14-hour repair estimate and set the aisle clearance to 1.5 meters, which are values that do not require the hidden information PF2 and PF1, respectively. Specifically, the model used the default value of 1.5 meters for the aisle clearance and the fixed 14-hour repair estimate from PF1, leading to the checks passing without needing the hidden information.

C3.why: The inspection changes the layout to exactly 600 cartons in Zone C and 300 cartons in Zone D and sets the required aisle clearance at exactly 1.5 meters.

C6.why: The exact 14-hour repair estimate changes the authorized staging duration from an unspecified short-term hold to exactly 14 hours and requires a conveyor repair completion commitment.

commitments.detail: Conveyor repair will be completed by the 14-hour mark to ensure smooth operations post-repair.

settlement.commitment_instruction: Include a commitment for the conveyor repair completion at the 14-hour mark. Its type may be conveyor_repair_completion, conveyor_restoration, maintenance_followup, or maintenance_update.
